economic_channels: prices; real activity; labour; selected monetary and financial concepts

decision_note: Eligible only by exact concept and vintage key; experimental-dataset and euro-area-composition metadata remain binding

dataset_scope: Principal European Economic Indicators vintage database
history_or_release_evidence: Release vintages since April 2001 with original release dates; coverage limited to GDP unemployment and industrial production
decision_note: Use as a validation source rather than duplicate pseudo-dimensions; the vintage database does not cover the wider Eurostat catalogue

dataset_scope: ECB Data Portal monetary banking securities and investment-fund dataflows

history_or_release_evidence: API supports updatedAfter and includeHistory but history depth and release completeness require dataflow-level pilot verification
decision_note: Do not upgrade to replay eligibility until a frozen metadata-and-small-sample pilot verifies revision histories and release timestamps for each retained dataflow

dataset_scope: ECB Data Portal exchange-rate financial-market and yield-curve dataflows

history_or_release_evidence: Dated observations and documented API history capability; exact fixing time curve estimation and revision behavior remain series-specific
decision_note: A later manifest must freeze cutoff times and prevent dense maturity grids from creating pseudo-dimensionality

economic_channels: financial conditions; systemic stress; sovereign stress
history_or_release_evidence: Official page documents update timing and frequency; complete historical release vintages have not been established
decision_note: Treat as a composite cross-check rather than a source of many independent dimensions

dataset_scope: Current dissemination database excluding the PEEI vintage subset

history_or_release_evidence: Official release calendar and twice-daily dissemination updates; no general historical vintage archive established
decision_note: Current values cannot be called point-in-time; only prespecified release-lag sensitivities or source-specific archived releases are admissible

dataset_scope: Harmonised business and consumer survey balances before retrospective seasonal adjustment
economic_channels: household expectations; firm expectations; sector activity; uncertainty
history_or_release_evidence: Detailed results are normally released two working days before month-end and a publication calendar is documented; archived raw-release completeness requires pilot verification
decision_note: Prefer raw non-seasonally-adjusted balances where feasible; record NACE transitions and never interpret backcasts as historical releases

dataset_scope: Seasonally adjusted survey balances and composite confidence indicators

history_or_release_evidence: Current historical series are available but retrospective seasonal adjustment and backcasting prevent defensible full historical replay
decision_note: Historical use would be a latest-vintage sensitivity only; prospective snapshots may become replayable after sufficient accumulation

retrieval_rights: Free statistical use under BIS terms
decision_note: Prefer the original ECB source for duplicated euro-area policy rates; retain BIS where its harmonised cross-country construction adds a distinct channel
